$comment: MACHINE half of the /healthz contract; the HUMAN half is health.md. The service imports this file for the response shape. One error code: a process that is not serving answers nothing; one whose opened store stops answering mid-life answers 503 db-unavailable (unverified by any row — health.md §Interface).

ok.description: the process is serving; a down process answers nothing

db.description: pvc = SQLite on /data/gateway.db; memory = the fail-open in-memory store (sessions do not survive a restart)

db-unavailable.description: the opened store does not answer SELECT 1 (unverified — no row; GW-HEALTH)
